_doc: Stable categories for the CI interrupt summary (skills/interrupt-summary). Order matters: a ticket takes the FIRST category whose `match` regex (case-insensitive, tested against the title) hits; titles no rule matches are left for Sift's manual pass. `what` / `change` (or `what` for stories) are the table text; edit them here when the picture changes for good, or override per run in notes.json. Keep category names stable so month-to-month numbers compare. Types other than Bug and Story (Employee offboarding, Sub-Task, ...) count as Task. Every Task category has `aim`: "address" (work we want off the board through product work or other tooling) or "keep" (work we are OK handling as interrupts); notes.json overrides can change it for one run.

Task.name: Routine ops
Task.what: Auto-created weekly deploy tickets, offboarding checklists, quarterly PersonalID syncs.
Task.change: Move to more frequent deploys and remove the deploy reminder task

Task.name: Feature flags & opp config
Task.match: microplan|audit(ing)? (flag|function)|feature flag|enable .*(feature|flag)|delivery type|intervention type|enable connect features
Task.what: Mostly "enable microplanning and audit" on an opportunity; also new delivery/intervention types.
Task.change: Make microplanning and auditing a setting in prod, and/or standard for all opps with a CHC intervention type. Work is underway to expose delivery/intervention types to admins in the UI (who counts as an admin is TBD).

Task.name: Worker unblocks
Task.what: Unblock a worker, reset PersonalID, reissue a backup code.
Task.change: No new action: email and backup-code reminders should help; monitor volume

Task.name: Access requests
Task.what: Connect roles, Superset, GitHub/Labs, Django admin and superuser access.
Task.change: Org admins manage roles; IT for tools

Task.name: Manual data fixes
Task.match: over ?limit visits|visit status|remove test user|data cleaning|post-assessment score
Task.what: Approving over-limit visits, changing visit status, removing test users.
Task.change: PM edits with an audit trail

Task.name: Infra & stability
Task.what: Celery memory and stalls, full RDS disk, 504s, slow PersonalID.
Task.change: Alerting; clarify whether specific infra changes go to Blue Pod or Interrupt
